description: FIFA men's national team world ranking (FIFA public ranking API, no key): position, team, country code, total points, previous points and previous rank for one ranking date. Default date is the latest one listed on FIFA's site when built (2026-10-20); pass dateId to read another listed date. Men's ranking only. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

dateId.description: Ranking date id such as id14870 (letters, digits and underscore, up to 40 characters; default id14870)

limit.description: How many teams from the top, 1 to 211 (default 20)

name: search_fifa_team_rankings
title: Search Fifa Team Rankings
